column1: # m5pro-safe-update migration policy. Columns (tab separated): SEVERITY  TAG  EXTENDED-REGEX  WHY
# The regex runs over the migration with comment lines removed. Highest severity wins: DEFER > REVIEW > INFO.
# DEFER   not run: recorded in /var/lib/m5pro-safe-update/deferred.tsv with a copy of the script, and marked done so
#         omarchy-migrate stops nagging. 'm5pro-safe-update --undefer NAME' puts it back, 'omarchy-migrate' then runs it.
# REVIEW  run, then every tracked file it changed is reported (system files we own are restored automatically).
# INFO    run; the tag is only shown.
# Anything matching nothing is SAFE and runs.

column4: Writes the ESP, initramfs or boot menu. The boot chain on this Mac is hand-built (m1n1/aura payload, A/B).
Rewrites pacman.conf or the keyring: loses IgnorePkg and the [m5pro]/[aur] sections.
Starts its own full upgrade outside this wrapper (only pacman.conf IgnorePkg applies, not the extra holds).
Edits the PAM stack that Touch ID sits in (sudo, polkit-1, lock screen): a bad edit locks sudo out.
Changes the login manager or network stack; this Mac uses tty2 autologin and its own network setup.
Names a package or file that this Mac carries its own build of.
Edits user config that the Hyprland/Omarchy-shell profile, plugins or macOS-feel items own.
Writes system config; tracked files it changes are restored automatically when we own them.
Removes packages. Escalates to DEFER when it names a protected package.
